start.text: Brannoc keeps one hand near his bowstring and watches the treeline more than your face.

choices.text: You saw the mule at the shrine. The toll disc in its eye.
The dog found a dead carter hidden in the pines.
Someone scraped a passenger name from the ledger.
The cut-bark mark near the ruts looked like smuggler work.
You know these woods?
I could use a hunter who knows the border roads.
Stay sharp.

toll_disc_reaction.text: Brannoc rubs rain from his beard and will not look toward the shrine. "Bad enough to kill a beast. Worse to make a message of it. Caravan men use coins for luck sometimes, aye, but not like that. Not unless someone wants the road blamed, or feared."

choices.text: You sound like you have seen travelers left behind before.
Then someone is using old fear as cover.
Leave it for now.

left_behind_pressure.text: His jaw works once before he answers. "Roads teach everyone the same lesson. You can save the cart, save the horses, or save the screaming. Anyone says they always saved all three is selling comfort."

choices.text: That sounds like confession, not advice.
Useful lesson. Ugly one.

not_confession_yet.text: "Then do not buy it yet." He checks the road behind you. "Find your caravan first. Judge ghosts after."

choices.text: For now.

old_fear_cover.text: "Maybe. Fear is cheap. Old fear is cheaper. Folk bring their own stories and do half the work for you."

choices.text: Then we look for who profits from panic.

carter_body_reaction.text: Brannoc's mouth tightens at the word carter. "A dog will sit with the dead longer than most men sit with the living. If someone hid him, they did it because the body said something the road was not meant to hear."

choices.text: You sound angry for someone who did not know him.
Then the body is evidence, not just a victim.

brannoc_carter_anger.text: "I know the work. Wet rope. Bad axles. Sleeping under wagons so thieves steal from someone easier. Cart men die poor and useful. That should buy them better than a hidden hollow."

choices.text: We will not leave him hidden.

erased_name_reaction.text: He stares at the scraped ledger line. "Bodies vanish on bad roads. Names vanish when someone with clean sleeves decides the dead are inconvenient. That is a colder sort of knife."

choices.text: You trust ledgers less than corpses.
Then someone with authority is near this.

brannoc_ledger_distrust.text: "A corpse at least tells you somebody paid. A ledger tells you who expects to be believed. Those are not the same thing."

choices.text: Good distinction.

smuggler_mark_reaction.text: Brannoc gives a humorless little laugh. "Blackfen marks are honest in one way. They say: law failed here, so someone bought another road. But a mark beside fresh ruts can be a guide, a warning, or bait."

choices.text: Which would you bet on?
Then we do not accuse Blackfen yet.

brannoc_smuggler_bet.text: "Bait. If smugglers took the caravan clean, we would not find their alphabet carved where every frightened fool can point at it."

choices.text: So someone wants us angry in the wrong direction.

woods.text: I know where the wolves drink, where the old stones sink, and where honest men stop walking after dusk.

choices.text: Then walk with me. I need someone who can read the wilds.
Useful knowledge.

recruit_offer.text: Brannoc studies you for a long moment. 'If this road leads to the missing caravan, I have reasons of my own to see it found.'

choices.text: Then we travel together.
Not yet.

joined.text: He gives a small nod, checks the fletching on three black-feathered arrows, and falls in beside the party.

end.text: He gives a small nod and falls quiet.
